MT.name: Avoid HP-restoring abilities
MT.note: Non-healers should avoid using any healing abilities that may cause their Accretion to pop early such as Second Wind, Curing Waltz or Divine Veil. If both Accretions are activated in a short amount of time, it will cause a wipe. Healers will need to manage HP burst accordingly to ensure that Accretions are not popped together. The H1 and H2 can throw single target heals at whoever has the Accretion between them. If playing AST, I recommend popping Macrocosmos immediately for the top-up as this will also take care of the tanks. WHM can use Benediction (if not used earlier) to instantly pop the healer Accretion.
